definitions.explanation: A social flying insect that collects nectar from flowers to produce honey and wax. Vital for pollination of many crops and wild plants.

examples.japanese: {蜜蜂|みつばち}が{花|はな}の{蜜|みつ}を{集|あつ}めている。
examples.english: Honeybees are collecting nectar from flowers.

examples.japanese: {蜜蜂|みつばち}に{刺|さ}されないように{気|き}をつけて。
examples.english: Be careful not to get stung by a bee.

examples.japanese: {養蜂|ようほう}{家|か}が{蜜蜂|みつばち}を{飼|か}って{蜂蜜|はちみつ}を{作|つく}る。
examples.english: Beekeepers raise honeybees to produce honey.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
・{蜜|みつ} (honey/nectar) + {蜂|はち} (bee) → {蜜蜂|みつばち} (honeybee)

TYPES OF BEES IN JAPANESE:
・ニホン{蜜蜂|みつばち} (Japanese honeybee - native species)
・セイヨウ{蜜蜂|みつばち} (Western honeybee - commonly raised for honey)
・スズメバチ (hornet - dangerous, aggressive)
・アシナガバチ (paper wasp)
・クマバチ (carpenter bee)

RELATED TERMS:
・{蜂蜜|はちみつ} (honey)
・{巣箱|すばこ} (beehive box)
・{養蜂|ようほう} (beekeeping)
・{受粉|じゅふん} (pollination)
・{女王蜂|じょおうばち} (queen bee)
・{働|はたら}き{蜂|ばち} (worker bee)

ECOLOGICAL IMPORTANCE: {蜜蜂|みつばち} are crucial pollinators for agriculture. Colony Collapse Disorder ({蜂群崩壊症候群|はちぐんほうかいしょうこうぐん}) is a growing environmental concern worldwide.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{蜜蜂|みつばち}に{刺|さ}される (to be stung by a bee)
・{蜜蜂|みつばち}を{飼|か}う (to keep bees)
